lines.text: Spies pretending to be sincere ask Jesus whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar.
Jesus asks whose image is on a denarius, and they answer Herod's.
The Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, tell Jesus about seven brothers.
Jesus says those in the resurrection can no longer die, because they are like the prophets.
Jesus says God is God of the living, not the dead, and they did not dare question Him further.
